q: A standard game of football (soccer) is played between two teams of ____ players each. (P2)
explain: Each football team fields 11 players including one goalkeeper.
hint: Number of players on a football team.

q: The only player on a football pitch permitted to touch the ball with hands inside the penalty box is the ____. (P2)
explain: Goalkeepers guard the goal and catch or deflect shots.

q: The official who enforces the rules and fairness during a football match is the ____. (P2)
explain: The referee controls the match and penalizes fouls.

q: Running at maximum top speed over short sprint distances (e.g. 50m, 100m) is called ____. (P2)
explain: Sprints require explosive anaerobic power.

q: Sports injury (P2): What is a Fracture?
options: a broken or cracked bone requiring immediate splinting and radiography
explain: A Fracture is a broken or cracked bone requiring immediate splinting and radiography.

q: Sports injury (P2): What is a Sprain?
options: a painful wrenching or tearing of ligaments around a joint (e.g. ankle)
explain: A Sprain is a painful wrenching or tearing of ligaments around a joint (e.g. ankle).

q: Sports injury (P2): What is a Dislocation?
options: the displacement of a bone end from its normal joint socket
explain: A Dislocation is the displacement of a bone end from its normal joint socket.

q: Sports injury (P2): What is a Cramp?
options: a sudden, involuntary, painful contraction of a muscle
explain: A Cramp is a sudden, involuntary, painful contraction of a muscle.
